NVDA.fair_value_reasoning: Screen only (the model update re-researches the path). Q3 Data Center +$4.2B vs build ($107.6B vs $103.44B); Q4 total guide midpoint $130.0B vs build $135.3B (-$5.3B, about -$5.3B of Data Center); net FY27 Data Center about -$1B on roughly $436B (-0.25%). Gross margin: Q3 +0.9pt (74.9% vs 74%) and Q4 guide midpoint 71.5% vs the 71% build, about +0.35pt on FY27. With the engine elasticities (dc_capture FY27 0.0053, gm FY27 0.009 per unit) that is about -0.001% and +0.003% on the research target (12m): net 0.0%. FY28-29 rows (where the value sits) are not moved by a number in the release; unsized: the $118B of credit guarantees and $102B of cloud/lease commitments tied to neoclouds that must secure financing (hs_self_funded, dc_mor), DSO 60 -> 64 days with extended payment terms (fcf_conv), and Q4 guide is typically conservative so the screen may overstate the Q4 gap. Sources: Ex. 99.1 and Ex. 99.2 of 8-K 0001045810-26-000088.
NVDA.breaks: Q3 and Q4 FY27 quarter builds (dc_capture 0.5259 supply-bound Q3 Data Center $103.44B vs actual $107.6B; Q4 revenue $135.3B vs guide $130.0B; Q3 gm 74% vs 74.9%). Also adds facts outside the scenarios: $390B supply commitments, $118B guarantees, $102B cloud/lease commitments, DSO 64 days.
